name: 3PO
name_note: 3PO is internal-only; rename before any public use (trademark proximity)
original_design: Original protocol-droid design, not C-3PO: a smooth seamless gold egg-dome head with no brow/forehead ridges, no ear discs and no nose ridge or mouth slot; a separate white angular faceplate (hexagonal shield with a chevron chin) split by ONE full-width horizontal visor slit that glows faint emerald (#2BD47D) instead of two round ringed eyes; two angled cheek seams that light up when talking (instead of a mouth); a short antenna nub with a white tip; a ribbed dark neck with a white collar ring; white chest panel. Palette: brand gold #B68231 with warmer #F0C46A edge tint, white panels, pure black.
fps_note: Rendered at 60 fps. 120 fps is feasible (curves are continuous; ~7.5 s/frame CPU Cycles at 768 => ~1.7 h extra) but not delivered in v1.
sizes_note: 64=32pt@2x, 96=32pt@3x, 128=64pt@2x, 192=64pt@3x, 512=256pt@2x, 768=256pt@3x. No 48 px: libx265 alpha aborts (free(): invalid next size) at 48x48; 64 encodes fine.
alpha: straight (un-premultiplied) alpha, rendered with Cycles film_transparent (not keyed). Colour: Rec.709 / sRGB, tv range in video files.

state_map.rule: switch states only at a loop boundary (after frame n-1), play X_to_Y, then the target loop from frame 0. Non-idle to non-idle goes via idle.

params.headTilt: deg (roll), + = clockwise as seen by the viewer
params.scanAngle: deg, eye_scan rotation about head up-axis
params.scanBoost: 0-1 extra brightness of the scan core

alert.note: alert ends in a 0.1 s still hold at neutral; the jump after frame 0 is the intended startle snap

verification.seam_metric: mean abs diff of premultiplied RGBA (0-255) between consecutive frames; seam = last->first

transition.play: start right after the last frame of the 'from' loop; continue with frame 0 of the 'to' loop
